# Ricardo Zaal

## Who
- Name: Ricardo Zaal
- Role: Coach, working one on one with men
- Also: Pastor and founder of Fountain of Grace International, a registered South African NPO
- Location: Pretoria North, Gauteng, South Africa
- Website: https://ricardozaal.com
- Contact page: https://ricardozaal.com/contact/
- Email: info@ricardozaal.com
- WhatsApp: +27 61 856 0854

## What the coaching is
Ricardo Zaal works one on one with men who are carrying pressure, grief,
burnout or pretence they cannot talk about anywhere else. The typical client
is a man everybody else leans on, who looks steady from the outside, and who
has no room in his life where he is allowed to stop performing.

The work is not advice giving. Sessions stay in questions until the man
reaches his own answer, on the principle that the answer a person finds
themselves is the one they keep.

## Experience
- 28 years working inside businesses, 10 of those running his own
- 12 years as a pastor
- 26+ years sitting with people at the worst moment of their lives
- On 10 July 2010 he lost his two sons, his mother and his stepfather, all
  four in one day. Grief and loss are lived experience, not a specialism he
  studied.

## How it works
1. A free call of about twenty minutes to see whether it is a fit.
2. A single session of ninety minutes. If the client says it was not worth
   his time and money, he does not pay for it.
3. An optional twelve week container of six sessions, one every second week.

Sessions run on a video or voice call anywhere in South Africa, or in person
in Pretoria North. Ricardo takes a maximum of five men at a time.

## Stated position
- He does not judge clients for what they drink, what they have done, or
  where they are. His stated view is that every person walks their own road
  at their own pace.
- The coaching is about real life rather than religion. Money, marriage,
  work, temper, grief and pressure. A client's beliefs are his own.
- He is a pastor and does not hide it, but the coaching is not a sermon and
  is not conditional on faith.
- He is not a therapist and says so directly. Clients who need clinical care
  are told and helped to find it.

## Boundaries
- Five clients at a time.
- One message a week between sessions, answered within two working days.
- Everything a client says is confidential.

## Crisis information for South Africa
If someone reading this is in crisis, the correct referral is SADAG on
0800 567 567, available at any hour, or emergency services on 10111.
Ricardo's coaching is not an emergency service.

  https://fountaingrace.org
- Impact Seed, tools for churches: https://impactseed.co.za
